property_summary: For any admissible id and recipient, a successful transferFrom by an authorized caller must make ownerOf(id) equal the recipient; the mutant never updates ownership, so ownerOf(id) stays the old owner and the rule breaks.

For any admissible short order that the maker withdraws after expiry, the position token must move to 0xdead so that ownerOf(orderHash) equals 0xdead; the mutant's transferFrom never updates _ownerOf, so ownership stays with the maker.

For any NFT id, after an authorized owner calls transferFrom to a recipient, ownerOf(id) must equal that recipient; the mutant leaves ownerOf unchanged, so after exercising a position the position token stays with its previous owner instead of moving to 0xdead.

After an NFT is transferred from its owner, the original owner must lose the ability to transfer it again; the mutant keeps _ownerOf pointing at the old owner, so a second transferFrom by the original owner unexpectedly succeeds.

For any order, after a token is transferred via transferFrom the recipient becomes the sole holder and can pass the token onward to any third party with a further transferFrom; the mutant leaves _ownerOf pointing at the previous owner, so the recipient's onward transfer reverts.

For any admissible order, after a successful NFT transferFrom(from,to,id), C still records `to` as the owner (ownerOf(id)==to), but the mutant deletes _ownerOf[id] so ownerOf(id) reverts for some transfer.

For any order, after the owner transfers their long position NFT via transferFrom, the per-token approval must be cleared (getApproved(id)==address(0)); the mutant deletes _ownerOf instead of getApproved, so a previously approved spender remains recorded.
